ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 3:2 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels concentrated medially to high-intensity (off-white/light grey) pixels concentrated distally.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity region extends from the peduncle through the central lobes. High-intensity distal fields are present on both lobes, with significant low-intensity mottling. Notable features include a discrete, high-contrast circular low-intensity spot on the distal left lobe and irregular stippling along the dark-to-light transition boundaries.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetrical V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 75 degrees; apex is clearly defined above the waterline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous micro-serrations with pixel-amplitude variations of 2-10 pixels; extreme lateral tips exhibit high-frequency, high-amplitude irregular protrusions caused by localized textured masses.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory from the median notch to the distal tips, interrupted at the extreme lateral margins by irregular, non-linear pixel clusters.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Significant clusters of irregular, high-contrast, multi-tonal (brown/tan) pixel masses localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-intensity, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks/scratches) of varying lengths (20-120 pixels) primarily detected on the low-intensity central regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle colonization clusters at both distal tips; multiple linear scars/rake marks breaking the natural pigmentation on the medial fluke surfaces.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, prominent low-intensity circular focal spot isolated within the high-intensity field of the left lobe.
